summary: Perion Network Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, furnishing a press release about a strategic partnership with Best Buy Canada to power its retail DOOH media network. The partnership involves Perion providing full-stack technology (Ad Server, SSP, Header Bidding) for programmatic in-store digital signage. No financial terms, stake percentages, prices, premiums, or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine commercial partnership announcement, not a special situation transaction. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a standard current report on Form 6-K for a foreign private issuer.
